speaker: Sera
text: I keep sending people to the wall. I would like to stand there myself for once. But I cannot leave this table open.
direction: Tired but direct; ask for a concrete favor, without accusation.

speaker: Sera
text: Take the blank cards. Bring back the empty tray too. People should have somewhere to put a question when they find one.
direction: Practical instruction, then gently make room for an unanswered question.

speaker: Sera
text: Stay on this side. If someone asks for a source, ask them to wait for me. You do not have to answer for anybody.
direction: A quiet, precise boundary before stepping away.

speaker: Sera
text: You brought the tray back empty. That is all right. An empty place for a question is still worth keeping.
direction: Accept the empty tray without disappointment.

speaker: Sera
text: I heard the voices from the wall instead of through this doorway. Thank you for staying.

speaker: Sera
text: Leave a space beside the account. Someone may come back with a question after we have gone.
direction: Make space for a future question without promising an answer.

speaker: Sera
text: I can take the table again. You do not have to stay here to make this account worth keeping.
direction: Release the runner from the favor; no implied debt.
